summary.description: 2-3 sentences: which parts of the technical foundation are holding the candidate back across these sessions

concepts.description: The technical concepts to study, most important first (up to 8)

concept.description: A specific technical concept, e.g. 'Quorum reads and writes', not 'databases'

why.description: What the candidate got wrong or left out, grounded in the sessions, in plain words

key_ideas.description: 2-4 short statements of what the candidate must understand to explain this at staff level

study.description: Where to learn it: a specific book chapter, paper, engineering blog post or docs page

sessions.description: Session numbers (1 = oldest in the window) where it showed up
